verdict.rationale: Jan ships a built-in OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337, documented as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs and optionally exposed on 0.0.0.0. Its docs also explicitly say Jan connects with Claude Code and OpenClaw, so a coding agent can plausibly use it as a model backend. missing for 10: detailed setup docs for pointing a specific coding agent at Jan, independent or hands-on corroboration that coding agents work reliably against it, and a published API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404).
